title: Sail On, Sail On, Oh Mighty Ship of State
author: Robin Andersen
content:
There’s a madman in the White House (or [what’s
left](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1190279966300386&set=a.648917950436593&id=100059551808655)
of it) who thinks he’s a king, and he’s threatening to send US Marines on a
[suicide mission](https://savageminds.substack.com/p/will-trump-go-
kamikaze?utm_source=post-email-
title&publication_id=65949&post_id=192709601&utm_campaign=email-post-
title&isFreemail=false&r=1qdvl&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email) to Iran,
but [67 percent of the US people](https://zeteo.com/p/are-these-trumps-worst-
poll-numbers-first-draft?utm_source=post-email-
title&publication_id=2325511&post_id=192536719&utm_campaign=email-post-
title&isFreemail=false&r=1qdvl&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email) are
against it. The reasons and goals were made up, as they moved through his
fever dreams on [“Truth Social”](https://deanblundell.substack.com/p/the-
wheels-just-came-off-israel-blew?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email) in the
middle of the night. “We’ve already [won the war](https://www.msn.com/en-
us/news/politics/trump-says-iran-war-already-won-attacks-chuck-schumer-in-
fiery-remarks/ar-
AA1Zvfko?gemSnapshotKey=GMF7535B27-snapshot-1&ocid=iehpOrigin),” the madman
was reported to say. It was a “preemptive strike,” but no enemy strike was
planned. The US left negotiations about to conclude and the war crimes started
the very next day. US bombs hit a [girls primary
school](https://substack.com/@ahmadibsais/note/c-222525418?r=1qdvl&utm_medium=ios&utm_source=notes-
share-action) leaving the parents to bury the bodies of their children.

At the gas pump a man [connects the
dots](https://substack.com/@parislychee/note/c-235407083?r=1qdvl&utm_medium=ios&utm_source=notes-
share-action) between the illegal war and our own depravations.

A Re[tired Major General](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1589363242180934) says
in disgust that the Secretary of Defense, a former Fox News TV personality who
was kicked out of the [National
Guard](https://www.facebook.com/OccupyDemocrats/posts/breaking-a-top-us-
general-torches-pete-hegseths-disgraceful-military-record-
and-/1469374481960788/), has no qualifications for the job. Pete Hegseth grabs
the spotlight with delusional [testosterone-fueled
bluster](https://mondoweiss.net/2026/03/gaming-the-iran-war-and-the-gaza-
genocide-
syndrome/?fbclid=IwY2xjawQ3qNlleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEe8MYxnuaapdn1aff5__MRUJtai5-0herm21y-ypIkQcFasz81ZKpaCF0Pq_w_aem_A8SXQ0BqFvTAjcsBoIdl_g)
staged to sound like war strategies, talking about the “[stupid rules of
engagement](https://www.facebook.com/OccupyDemocrats/posts/breaking-a-top-us-
general-torches-pete-hegseths-disgraceful-military-record-
and-/1469374481960788/)” he won’t follow. Instead, he instructs our “war
fighters” to “hunt down” and “kill” our enemies. Shaking his head the Major
General says, “Those are the words of a potential war criminal.” Hegseth is
apparently unaware that he may be sending Marines to the “graveyard of the
American Empire,” as former presidential candidate Dennis Kucinich tells the
[_Scheer Intelligence_ ](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/scheer-
intelligence/id1054586928?i=1000753129454)podcast.

Marco Rubio claimed US bombs were instigated by Israel, a state reviled the
world over for its genocide of Palestinians that [destroyed all the
schools,](https://substack.com/@jemby123/note/c-235220701?r=1qdvl&utm_medium=ios&utm_source=notes-
share-action) the clinics, the hospitals, the mosques, the housing, the water,
and the sanitation in the Gaza Strip. Then they hired influencers, ([but
didn’t pay them](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israels-hasbara-
directorate-being-sued-unpaid-activists-claiming-millions)) to keep calling
their slaughter in Gaza a hoax. Behind-the-screens Israel now destroys
Lebanese villages just like they did in Gaza, and [kills journalists and first
responders](https://x.com/DropSiteNews/status/2038856924830081054?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email),
just like they did in Gaza, [for the same
reasons](https://mondoweiss.net/2026/03/gaming-the-iran-war-and-the-gaza-
genocide-
syndrome/?fbclid=IwY2xjawQ3qNlleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEe8MYxnuaapdn1aff5__MRUJtai5-0herm21y-ypIkQcFasz81ZKpaCF0Pq_w_aem_A8SXQ0BqFvTAjcsBoIdl_g)—to
stop the truth from getting out.

US Marines are sent to retrieve a mysterious prize, because God’s chosen
people, as Gideon Levy called Israelis, don’t have any soldiers to send. They
are busy [killing in the West Bank](https://ahmadibsais.substack.com/p/the-
genocide-of-the-west-bank-the?utm_source=post-email-
title&publication_id=1020749&post_id=192157033&utm_campaign=email-post-
title&isFreemail=true&r=1qdvl&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email) and
torturing the doctors and nurses and even the children in their dungeons of
inhuman hate.

**“Through the Squalls of Hate’”**

Francesca Albanese releases yet another report on the heinous crimes
perpetrated against Palestinians, this time through Isreal’s [widespread
systematic and sadistic](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Z-GKi9VWnU) use of
torture of thousands of prisoners kidnapped since October 7, who are beaten,
raped and starved to death on a scale of brutality never seen before in the
modern world. And the story of a Rabbi who was once a tank sergeant in
Israel’s army, arrested for [sexually abusing a
child](https://www.instagram.com/p/DIJCLzyga26/), is re-circulated online, but
never makes it to corporate media. He was also known for having publicly
spread the false claims about Hamas systematically raping Israeli women on
October 7. Yes, every Israeli accusation is a confession, and they are the one
who [use human shields](https://www.btselem.org/topic/human_shields).

Islamophobia runs wild with the [howls of right-wing
politicians](https://bridge.georgetown.edu/today_islamophobia/march-27-2026/)
repeated by their favorite media outlets.

And the once high-value news source—rendered now as little more than a tired-
grey shipwreck of a
newspaper—[recounts](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2026/03/25/business/energy-
environment/strait-hormuz-oil-
gas.html?utm_content=buffercc657&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter.com&utm_campaign=buffer)
with grand illustrations the “exceptionally critical journey” of the sacred
“oil and gas tankers,” and how their precious cargos proceed globally in a
truly moving story. There were no moving headlines in the legacy press about
the 18-month-old toddler whose legs were burned with cigarettes by Israeli
torturers. We saw his small [blood-soaked
pants](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/gaza-toddler-released-israeli-
custody-cigarette-burn-wounds) telling a story that should have been printed
above the fold on every newspaper if the media’s mandate was still democracy.

Some independent commentators conclude that “[we are the
villains](https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#search/we+are+the+baddies/WhctKLbvXbgkQbVdpBXnsqTqCZPVxpPxqtnjqLFqBxCMwSkpPzVdFHzkvnfGnjCdXxvqVHb)
in this story.” Another posts warns that [nuclear weapons are
poised](https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#inbox/WhctKLcDrdVwQCRCSjHZVMXRfklfzccTvrzBCBTmVPQqslsgPZWLqzWwDgvddWPwNDjlrVv)
to wipe out the Middle East, and the Israeli [death
cult](https://x.com/MaxBlumenthal/status/2038688915956068387) passes a [far-
right inspired death](https://www.palestinechronicle.com/explainer-what-does-
israels-final-vote-on-death-penalty-for-palestinians-
mean/?utm_source=emailoctopus&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=The%20Palestine%20Chronicle%20Newsletter%2C%20March%2030)
penalty law making it easier for them to execute Palestinians. Israeli police
[beat anti-war and anti-occupation
protester](https://www.facebook.com/reel/2382405295568060)s and judicial
critics at HaBima Square in Tel Aviv.

**Democracy is Coming, to the USA**

Palestinian Pulitzer Prize winning writer [Mosab Abu
Toba](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1Aw3WxL3k6/), sings a heart wrenching
melody accapela in Riverside Church overlooking the Hudson where MLK shouted
out his opposition to the Vietnam War. Bruce Springsteen takes the stage and
thrills as he sings _The Streets of Minneapolis_ , just after the wise Angela
Davis reminds those in the pews [celebrating Democracy
Now!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M384Jv3EeiY&t=7976s) that protests are a
form of resistance that gives us the feeling of our own power. They are
rehearsals for the revolution about to be born.

Patti Smith sings “People Have the Power,” with her arms spread out in a holy
gesture as a writer belts out the song and passes out postcards of where to
see the film, [_Steal this Story, Please_](https://stealthisstory.org/) _._
Within a week in the USA, 9 million people would protest against the mad king
in what was left of the White House.

The post [Sail On, Sail On, Oh Mighty Ship of
State](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/04/03/sail-on-sail-on-oh-mighty-ship-
of-state/) appeared first on [CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
